description: This file contains utility functions for internationalization and hashing related to the 'pi' engine within a documentation project's internationalization system. It includes environment variable checks, text normalization, hashing functions, and cache key generation for translation segments.

methods.name: cacheNamespace
methods.description: Generates a namespace string based on the workflow version, engine name, provider, and model, used for caching.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Creates a SHA256 hash-based key from provided namespace, language info, segment ID, and text hash for caching purposes.

methods.name: hashText
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the normalized input text.

methods.name: hashBytes
methods.description: Returns a SHA256 hash of the input byte array.

methods.name: normalizeText
methods.description: Trims whitespace and reduces all inner whitespace sequences in the input text to a single space.

methods.name: docsPiProvider
methods.description: Determines the provider name (e.g., 'openai', 'anthropic') based on environment variables or defaults.

methods.name: docsPiModel
methods.description: Selects the model name based on the provider, environment variables, or default values.

methods.name: segmentID
methods.description: Creates a segment ID string composed of the relative path and a shortened text hash.

methods.name: splitWhitespace
methods.description: Splits a string into three parts: leading whitespace, main content, and trailing whitespace.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Logs an error message to stderr and exits the program if an error occurs.
